audit_items.proof_trace: Race condition: MaxBlobsPerBlock performs in-place sorting of shared BlobSchedule slice without synchronization. BeaconConfig() releases RLock before MaxBlobsPerBlock executes, allowing concurrent goroutines to write to the same slice during sort operations, causing data races and potentially inconsistent max blob limits.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker crafts blocks at epoch boundaries when BlobSchedule may be unsorted. Concurrent block processing causes race in MaxBlobsPerBlock sort (lines 707-709), leading to inconsistent reads where one goroutine sees a higher limit than another for the same epoch, allowing bypass of blob count validation.
